headline: BCR PMI analysis: August recorded the biggest improvement in production conditions in Romania in the last two years
summary: Romania's BCR PMI recorded the largest improvement in goods-producing production conditions in two years in August. Stronger new orders and higher production volumes drove the gain.
why: The PMI is a monthly survey of purchasing managers that gives an early read on manufacturing activity, which investors use to gauge the health of an economy.
